title: Earliest-stop reference slices
requirement: WHEN multiple reference transitions share one physical step or chunk, the implementation SHALL expose the ordered ReferenceSlice through its earliest reference stop.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Grouped pending return
scenarios.when: A candidate groups up to 1, 2, 4 or 8 reference transitions around a callee return under the same schedule/bounds.
scenarios.then: StepRecord preserves each internal position, rule/source occurrence, prefix charge, logical frame check and first outcome. Under sherlock-k-a/1 zero-fuel terminal/error publication and frame-cap Rejected(error4) keep their original precedence; padding adds physical work only. Technical cuts retain complete resumable state and create no financial commit or movement of an existing Core/2 await prefix.

expected.sherlock-k-a/1 precedence: zero-fuel terminal/error publication and frame-cap Rejected(error4) unchanged; padding adds physical work only

scenarios.blocker: needs a ReferenceSlice grouping entrypoint (group up to 1, 2, 4 or 8 reference transitions around a callee return) exposing StepRecord internals
